channel.title: WPRT-FM 102.5 The Game - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from WPRT-FM 102.5 The Game (thegamenashville.com)

item.title: House advances boxing-reform act, but questions remain
item.description: Questions and answers about the reform bill and its impact on the sport.

item.title: House passes Ali Revival Act; bill heads to Senate
item.description: The Muhammad Ali Boxing Revival Act, which would shift the structure of pro boxing by allowing Unified Boxing Organizations as options for boxers, passed the U.S. House of Representatives by a voice vote Tuesday.

item.title: Reds’ Lodolo will start season on IL due to blister
item.description: Cincinnati Reds left-handed pitcher Nick Lodolo will open the season on the injured list as he recovers from a blister on his left index finger.

item.title: UNC fires coach Davis after early tourney exit
item.description: North Carolina men's basketball coach Hubert Davis was fired by the school after another early exit in the NCAA tournament.

item.title: Arsenal teach Chelsea a Champions League lesson in clinical finishing
item.description: Arsenal will head into the second leg of their UWCL quarterfinal against Chelsea with a commanding 3-1 lead thanks to some lethal finishing from Stina Blackstenius, Chloe Kelly and Alessia Russo.

item.title: Who’s next at UNC? Potential candidates to replace Hubert Davis, their priorities
item.description: Hubert Davis is out after five seasons in Chapel Hill. Here are names expected to be on the short list.

item.title: L.A. spoils Tiger’s return, cruises to TGL title
item.description: Tiger Woods competed for the first time in more than a year and that wasn't nearly enough to stop Los Angeles Golf Club, which made three straight eagles to close out a 9-2 victory in the TGL finals Tuesday night to capture the SoFi Cup.

item.title: Sources: Saints fill out QB room, add Z. Wilson
item.description: The Saints have agreed to a one-year deal with QB Zach Wilson, sources confirmed to ESPN's Adam Schefter.

item.title: Grizzlies rule Morant’s season over due to elbow
item.description: Ja Morant will miss the rest of the season with an ulnar collateral ligament sprain in his left elbow but is expected to be ready for the start of the 2026-27 season.

item.title: Freed-Hardeman claims 2nd NAIA title in 3 years
item.description: - Phil Horton scored 18 points, Jailen Anderson added 16 and Freed-Hardeman (Tenn.) beat Langston (Okla.) 76-71 on Tuesday night for its second NAIA championship in three seasons.
